title: CredentialLease
description: What `acquire` returns: which pool entry an attempt rides, as a reference. Credentials are read at spawn, so a lease is part of an attempt's immutable pinned composition and a rotation reaches a running lane only through a respawn. There is no field a credential value can occupy.

subscription_identity.description: The entry's own decoded identity claim. Entries are keyed by identity and never by label: two identically-named labels have hidden two different accounts.

secret_fingerprint.description: A reference, never a value. This is the only credential-shaped field the lease carries.

entry_state.description: Three orthogonal axes. AUTH is not QUOTA is not REACH: collapsing them is what prescribes a re-mint against a credential that was never broken.
